description: This file is a Perl script implementing a minimal example of a Git filter protocol version 2, serving as a pass-through filter with basic packet I/O operations and filter command handling.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN according to the Git filter protocol, returning status and content or terminating on EOF or errors.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, ensuring it is properly terminated, by calling packet_bin_read.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT following the Git filter protocol.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet with proper framing by calling packet_bin_write.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by sending a flush marker.
